trade_summary: Long NVDA ahead of earnings, expecting AI-driven revenue beat to push stock 10%+ higher within one week.
verdict_reason: Buying into NVDA earnings has historically produced volatile outcomes. While AI tailwinds are real, the stock already prices in significant optimism, making a buy-the-rumor-sell-the-news reaction a material risk. Three similar setups showed mixed results with high volatility in all cases.

scenarios.title: NVDA Q2 2023 Earnings Beat
scenarios.what_happened: NVDA reported Q2 FY2024 earnings with revenue of $13.5B vs $11.1B expected — a massive beat driven by data center AI demand. Stock had already rallied 200% YTD going into the report.
scenarios.lesson: When AI demand fundamentally surprises the street, even overbought stocks can push higher — but gains came after an initial dip.

scenarios.title: NVDA Q3 2024 Earnings — Buy the Rumor
scenarios.what_happened: NVDA beat estimates again with Blackwell GPU demand, but the stock had already priced in perfection. Despite a strong report, shares fell 2.5% after hours as guidance was only in-line, not a blowout.
scenarios.lesson: When a stock trades at 35x forward earnings and 'good' is already priced in, even a beat can disappoint the market.

scenarios.title: Meta AI Capex Surprise Q1 2024
scenarios.what_happened: Meta raised capex guidance citing AI infrastructure spend. Stock dropped 15% despite a revenue beat because investors feared AI spending was outpacing monetization timelines.
scenarios.lesson: AI enthusiasm can reverse violently when investors question ROI timelines — even for fundamentally strong businesses.

key_risks: Earnings already priced in — NVDA trades at premium valuation leaving little room for disappointment
Buy-the-rumor-sell-the-news pattern has played out multiple times in 2024–2025
Macro sensitivity — any Fed commentary or bond yield spike during earnings week amplifies downside
suggested_action: Consider reducing position size to 50% of intended and placing a tight stop-loss 5% below entry. If holding through earnings, use options to define your risk rather than outright stock exposure.

input.trade_idea: NVDA is about to report earnings and AI demand is still strong. I want to buy before the report expecting a 10%+ move up.
